question: Do centered terminal remainders and their nonzero alternating projections replay for all84 exact source-bound n83 inputs?

claims.text: Generate and replay full centered terminal coefficients, exact degrees and both projected U-polynomials for all84 source-bound cases.
This run does not compute exact LFD, CM regularity, solving degree or a factor-base speed comparison.

arms.description: original retained prime m3-9 and explicitly synthetic centered/adjacent target controls
baseline retained prime m3-9 and explicitly synthetic centered/adjacent target controls
spike40 retained prime m3-9 and explicitly synthetic centered/adjacent target controls

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact computations only; no clock or statistical comparison.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Embedded positive controls:21 centered targets must have remainder degree15 with nonzero projected U^2 P coefficient,21 adjacent targets degree16. Native small exhaustive tests and primality controls passed before freeze.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Development mutation controls reject altered parent bytes, source, base identity, wrapper target/weights and coefficients. No separate random null population is claimed for exact arithmetic.

primary.name: remainder_degree
primary.definition: Ordinary total degree of the full centered terminal remainder, including U.

secondary.name: projection_nonzero
secondary.definition: Whether the exact alternating projection is nonzero.

secondary.name: centered_target
secondary.definition: Whether target equals half the last-block weight sum.

stopping_rules.rule: All84 cases, then full native byte replay; no case omission.
600s per phase,2GiB each,1500s worker,1800s Job,zero retries; preserve inputs before generation and each completed case immediately.

invalidation_rules: Any exact source/base/input/projection/degree/byte-replay mismatch invalidates the affected record.
Partial execution does not establish complete panel coverage.
Remainder degree is not an exact LFD or regularity value.

decision_rule.text: Record arithmetic_verified after matching sources and exact replay. Centered controls should have degree15 and the other63 cases degree16, each with nonzero projection.
decision_rule.statistic: Exact degrees and projection checks per case

graphs: Exact remainder degree by target kind and m, including failed or incomplete records.

inadmissible: Reporting final basis degree as solving degree
Using timeout as a degree bound
Downscaling n or omitting m cells
Claiming an IC/rho speedup or subgroup attack from this stage
Equating closure plateau with global stabilization
Inferring lower regularity or elite factor-base quality from low FFD/LFD alone
